_description: Music bed library. Names referenced from JSON specs as 'library://music/<name>'.
_how_to_add: Drop a file here named <name>.mp3 (or .wav/.ogg/.flac). Loopable instrumental, 60s+ recommended.

_referenced_by_example.cozy_piano_01: default music bed (also for melancholy → swap to piano_rain_01)
_referenced_by_example.intro_theme: channel intro background (under 'Welcome to channel THAI Novel')

_ai_replacements.cozy_piano_01_ai: original generated cozy piano bed; use as library://music/cozy_piano_01_ai
_ai_replacements.playful_uke_01_ai: original generated playful plucked bed; use as library://music/playful_uke_01_ai
_ai_replacements.strings_warm_02_ai: original generated warm strings bed; use as library://music/strings_warm_02_ai
_ai_replacements.piano_rain_01_ai: original generated melancholy piano/rain bed; use as library://music/piano_rain_01_ai
_ai_replacements.intro_theme_ai: original generated intro theme; use as library://music/intro_theme_ai

_notes: Royalty-free sources: pixabay.com/music, freemusicarchive.org, incompetech.com (Kevin MacLeod). Match the cozy/romantic palette.
